description: An answer with a session-html widget whose script probes the sandbox (cookies, fetch to the app, top-level navigation) and saves its input through window.sessionWidgetState. Used by the widget end-to-end test.

parts.delta: The widget below reports what its script can reach from the sandbox.

```session-html id=sandbox-probe title="Sandbox probe"

Scripts have not run.

cookie: not read

fetch: not tried

top navigation: not tried

<script>
const out = (id, text) => { document.getElementById(id).textContent = text; };
out('status', 'Scripts ran.');
try { out('cookie', 'cookie: ' + JSON.stringify(document.cookie)); } catch (error) { out('cookie', 'cookie: blocked (' + error.name + ')'); }
const app = location.ancestorOrigins && location.ancestorOrigins[0];
if (app) { fetch(app + '/api/trpc/auth.me', { credentials: 'include' }).then((response) => out('fetch', 'fetch: status ' + response.status), (error) => out('fetch', 'fetch: failed (' + error.name + ')')); } else { out('fetch', 'fetch: no app origin'); }
try { top.location.href = (app || 'https://example.com') + '/widget-navigated'; out('top', 'top navigation: allowed'); } catch (error) { out('top', 'top navigation: blocked (' + error.name + ')'); }
const note = document.getElementById('note');
window.sessionWidgetState.onRestore((value) => { note.value = value && value.version === 1 && typeof value.text === 'string' ? value.text : ''; });
note.addEventListener('input', () => window.sessionWidgetState.save({ version: 1, text: note.value }));
</script>
```
Every conclusion is in the prose: the widget only illustrates the sandbox.
